name: synergy-engine
description: Topic-Synergy Outreach Engine — find the people writing about your topics (and the people you cited) and reach them without pitching. Builds a topic fingerprint from your own content, then runs THREE discovery centers. AUTHOR center (named profiles via Apify harvestapi/linkedin-profile-posts) and CONTENT center (keyword/hashtag search via Apify harvestapi/linkedin-post-search) are comment-first, starting from who's posting; discovered posts are scored against the fingerprint, deduped against an xlsx tracker, and queued, then /synergy-run executes the comment-first decision tree (like + a practitioner comment, then the cite-then-tell lever and a connection note) with a hard human gate and a guard against the LinkedIn 'Post as' identity selector. The new CITATION center starts from who you cited: /synergy-cite-harvest parses your paper's bibliography, triages by reachability, resolves authors via OpenAlex/ORCID, dedups against Clarify, enriches person + org via Apollo (LinkedIn-first match + a verify gate against wrong-person matches), verifies LinkedIn identity via Apify, and drafts a 'we cited you' email + a hook-free connect note into a citation registry; /synergy-cite-run sends email first (Mailtrap as you, BCC you) then the LinkedIn connect, with the hard-won send discipline (type the note in separate click+type calls to beat the focus-race truncation bug, zoom-verify the note's start and end before Send, 2nd/3rd/high-follower button geography, the email-verification gate, never withdraw to re-send); /synergy-cite-accept-check follows through on accepted invites. /synergy-schedule stands up an every-other-day prep task. Cadence + guardrails baked in: comment same-day/connect later, the ~20-25/day LinkedIn connect ceiling, cite-don't-pitch, Dorian-voice, verified citations only. The plugin never auto-sends. v0.2.0.
